scope: Same supplied split and seed; not independent test evidence.

posthoc_remainder.warning: Not a clean or independent test: at least 27 of these have smaller confirmed overlaps; the same validation set also selected models/epochs. This post-hoc subset cannot quantify inflation or remove selection bias.

method: SIFT/RANSAC candidate search, then direct comparison of original ZIP pixels after integer translation; all RGB values must match in the full overlap region of at least 10000 pixels. Counts are confirmed lower bounds, not proof that other images are independent.
